data.body: Review remediation for Gerrit 2950 PS1: LLM-Review correctly found that any cancelled/skipped gate was taking precedence over a real failure. Amended render ordering so a non-empty all-success set is GREEN, a set with no failures but incomplete/unknown results is UNAVAILABLE, and any real failure remains RED even if another gate is cancelled. Added tests for failure+cancelled staying RED, neutral/timed_out/action_required/stale reporting UNAVAILABLE, and empty job sets explicitly reporting UNAVAILABLE. Validation after amendment: targeted main-health/concurrency tests passed (56 passed); full make verify with PYTEST_WORKERS=2 and GIT_CONFIG_* unset passed.
